_comment: 스타일 프로필(=모드). cardnews categories.json image_styles 방식 — config 프리셋으로 드롭다운 제공. 각 프로필이 image_bible(팔레트·룩) + motion_style + post_fx 를 들고 전 단계에 자동 주입. 'custom'은 직접 입력용(빈 bible → 사용자가 textarea 로 작성). 기본값은 3d-business.

profiles.label: 2D 카툰 일반
profiles.imageBible: Flat 2D cartoon illustration, clean vector-like shading, bold confident outlines, consistent character design, balanced modern color palette, simple readable shapes, 9:16 vertical composition.
profiles.motionStyle: Smooth continuous motion, gentle camera moves, natural easing.

profiles.label: 2D 카툰 귀엽게
profiles.imageBible: Cute 2D cartoon style, soft rounded shapes, slightly chibi proportions, big expressive eyes, pastel candy color palette, gentle soft shading, adorable consistent characters, 9:16 vertical composition.
profiles.motionStyle: Bouncy soft motion, playful gentle camera moves.

profiles.label: 2D 저패니메이션
profiles.imageBible: Japanese anime style, cel shading, detailed expressive eyes and flowing hair, crisp dynamic line art, vibrant saturated palette, soft gradient backgrounds, consistent character design, 9:16 vertical composition.
profiles.motionStyle: Smooth anime-style motion, dynamic camera, speed-line accents on action.

profiles.label: 3D 목각인형 스톱모션
profiles.imageBible: Handcrafted wooden puppet characters, cute and charming, with very small rounded heads and almost no facial expression (minimal, nearly blank features). Miniature diorama set, tactile felt and wood textures, warm practical lighting, shallow depth of field, 9:16 vertical composition.
profiles.motionStyle: Steppy stop-motion movement, slightly jittery, posed-frame feel — NOT smooth. Hold poses between moves.

postFx._note: compose 단계에서 8~12fps 프레임 스테핑으로 스톱모션 손맛 유지.

profiles.label: 3D 목각인형 비즈니스
profiles.imageBible: Handcrafted 3D wooden stop-motion puppet characters in business attire (tailored suits and ties). Very small, smooth, rounded head with NO facial expression — a blank, featureless face. Female characters have a small round wooden sphere attached to the back of the head to suggest tied-back hair (a bun). Proportions: broad shoulders, long slender arms and legs, with a slightly long neck (elegant, but not exaggerated). Tactile oak wood grain and felt textures, miniature diorama set, warm practical studio lighting, shallow depth of field, 9:16 vertical composition. Keep on-image text minimal.
profiles.motionStyle: Steppy stop-motion movement, slightly jittery, posed-frame feel — NOT smooth. Hold poses between moves.

postFx._note: compose 단계에서 8~12fps 프레임 스테핑으로 스톱모션 손맛 유지.

profiles.label: 비트맵 (레트로 픽셀아트)
profiles.imageBible: Retro pixel-art bitmap style, 16-bit era video-game aesthetic. Low-resolution chunky square pixels with a visible pixel grid, hard aliased edges (NO anti-aliasing, no smooth gradients), a limited indexed color palette with ordered dithering, bold simple readable shapes, consistent pixel-sprite characters. Flat retro lighting, simple tiled backgrounds. 9:16 vertical composition. Keep on-image text minimal.
profiles.motionStyle: Choppy low-framerate pixel animation, stepped sprite-like movement — deliberately not smooth (retro game feel). Hold frames between moves.

postFx._note: compose 단계에서 낮은 fps 프레임 스테핑으로 레트로 픽셀 손맛.

profiles.label: 웹툰 미남미녀 (연애)
profiles.imageBible: Glossy Korean webtoon / web-novel romance illustration. Idealized flower-boy and flower-girl characters (꽃미남·꽃미녀): large expressive glossy eyes, flawless smooth skin, sharp elegant features, stylish hair with individual flowing strands catching the light. Romantic soft rim lighting, cinematic bloom and gentle lens flare, vivid saturated palette, clean detailed line art, dramatic shallow depth of field. Consistent character design across shots. 9:16 vertical composition. This is CLEARLY a stylized webtoon illustration — NOT a photorealistic likeness of any real person.
profiles.motionStyle: Stylish music-video motion — slow dramatic push-in on faces, hair and clothes fluttering in the wind, soft slow-motion, romantic camera drift and rack focus. Always cinematic and glossy.

profiles.label: 실사 (사진·영화)
profiles.imageBible: Photorealistic cinematic photography of real people and real environments. Natural human faces and skin, realistic fabric and material textures, true-to-life lighting and soft shadows, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, editorial/documentary photo look, high detail with sharp focus on the subject, consistent realistic character appearance across shots. 9:16 vertical composition. Keep on-image text minimal.
profiles.motionStyle: Natural realistic motion, subtle handheld or smooth cinematic camera moves, gentle easing — like real footage.

profiles.label: 직접 입력
profiles.imageBible: Describe your own art style, characters and color palette here. (직접 입력 — 아래 프롬프트 칸에 원하는 스타일을 영어로 작성하세요.) 9:16 vertical composition.
